Eur. also includes Garlic for Homoeopathic Preparations. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Garlic Powder). It is produced from garlic that has been cut, freeze-dried or dried at a temperature not exceeding 65°, and powdered. It contains not less than 0.45% of allicin, cal- culated with reference to the dried drug. It is a light yellowish powder. Protect from light. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Garlic for Homoeopathic Preparations). The fresh bulb of Allium sativum. Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. USP 31 (Garlic). The fresh or dried compound bulbs of Allium sativum (Liliaceae). It contains not less than 0.5% of alliin and not less than 0.2% of γ-glutamyl-(S)-allyl-L-cysteine, calculated on the dried basis. Store in a dry place at a temperature of 8° to 15°. Protect from light. USP 31 (Powdered Garlic). It is produced from garlic that has been cut, freeze-dried or dried at a temperature not exceeding 65°, and powdered. It contains not less than 0.3% of alliin and not less than 0.1% of γ-glutamyl-(S)-allyl-L-cysteine, calculated on the dried basis. Store in a dry place at a temperature of 8° to 15°.
